en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a narrow coastal road squeezed between a steep rocky cliff on the left and whitewashed houses on the right. The sea and a damaged or partially collapsed seafront structure are visible along the left side. Several roadwork or warning signs stand in the middle distance where the road bends around the rock, and there are a few people near the works. The style and wear suggest an older postcard, likely mid‑20th century.
